attrs.label: Scan Interval
attrs.description: How often to run diagnostic scans.

attrs.label: Mount Docker Socket
attrs.description:
Mount the Docker socket to enable container monitoring.</br>
This gives the app full control over Docker socket.

attrs.label: Mount /dev
attrs.description:
Mount /dev to enable SMART disk health monitoring and GPU device access.</br>
Required for SMART to work on most systems.

attrs.label: Mount /sys
attrs.description:
Mount /sys to enable GPU telemetry (NVIDIA/Intel/AMD) and drive mapping.</br>
Required for GPU monitoring.

attrs.label: Port Bind Mode
attrs.description:
The port bind mode.</br>
- Publish: The port will be published on the host for external access.</br>
- Expose: The port will be exposed for inter-container communication.</br>
- None: The port will not be exposed or published.</br>
Note: If the Dockerfile defines an EXPOSE directive,
the port will still be exposed for inter-container communication regardless of this setting.

1.0.0.readme:
NAS Doctor

NAS Doctor is a local diagnostic and monitoring tool for your NAS.

!!! WARNING !!!

This application requires additional elevated permissions beyond standard containerization protections. Use at your own risk.

The following additional privileges may be enabled from installing this application:

• Docker Socket Access

• Extended System Capabilities

• Host Networking
